name: Zámoly (Hungary)
description: Three vertical stripes of green, yellow and green in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zámoly (a yellow and green shield with a beehive, bees, grapes and a plough) below the name ZÁMOLY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
